csv_scope_of_work: The Massachusetts Department of Transportation (MassDOT) is soliciting Letters of Interest from parties interested in the RFQ package for the Design-Build Project consisting of the completion of the design and construction for: BEVERLY - Bridge Replacement, B-11-001 Bridge Street over Bass River (Hall-Whitaker Bridge), DESIGN-BUILD (605276). The Project is located in Beverly in MassDOT District 4 (Essex County). The Project limits extend westto-east along Bridge Street from Winthrop Avenue to River Street and north up Margin Street to the intersection with Federal Street. The Project scope includes all aspects of design, and construction of a new Hall-Whitaker Bridge over the Bass River including approach roadways and utilities, compliance with all environmental permits to be secured and/or amended by final design, public outreach, and any/all coordination with abutting or interested parties and stakeholders. The Project also includes the full deconstruction and demolition of the temporary bridge structure and all associated site restoration, upon completion of the new permanent bridge structure.
